title: Simple Note-Taking App
description: An application for creating, organizing, and managing notes efficiently.

features.name: Create Notes
features.description: Allows users to create and save text-based notes.

features.name: Organize Notes
features.description: Provides functionality to categorize and organize notes for easy retrieval.

features.name: Search Notes
features.description: Enables users to search for specific notes using keywords.

target_users: Individuals looking for a simple tool to manage their notes
